SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=2.
NUMBER right=4.
NUMBER middle=2.
NUMBER top=4.
NUMBER bottom=2.
NUMBER value=values[0].
IF (value%2==0) { left+=1. }
IF (value%2==0) { top+=1. }
value=values[1].
IF (value%2==0) { right+=1. }
IF (value%2==0) { bottom+=1. }
value=values[2].
IF (value%2==0) { middle+=1. }
IF (value%2==0) { left+=1. }
value=values[3].
IF (value%2==0) { left+=1. }
IF (value%2==0) { top+=1. }
DISPLAYNL(left+right+middle+bottom).
